Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 27-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Bhilai Project Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 27th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech and M.E/M.Tech in ECE/CSE/IT/AI&ML or related fields with at least 60% marks or a CGPA of 6.5 on a 10-point scale, along with a valid GATE/NET score.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years as of the application deadline. Age relaxation is available for outstanding candidates or those with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Junior Research Fellow (JRF) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus 18% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Bhilai Project Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their duly completed application form and resume to the provided email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT Bhilai.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIT Bhilai offer any age relaxation for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation may be provided to outstanding candidates or those possessing relevant experience.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
